name: Blueprint
description: White/cyan linework on cyanotype blue: a technical grid, precise construction geometry, dimension lines, callouts and a title block, organised like an engineering sheet.
visual_characteristics: deep blue base (#0b3d91-#104a9c) with a two-level grid (minor and major lines)
line hierarchy: thick object outline, medium hidden/section lines, hairline construction/dimension lines
dimension arrows, leader lines, numbered callouts, centre lines (dash-dot), section marks
title block with drawing number, scale, notes; small revision table

palette.guidance: Base cyanotype blue (#0d3b8c) with a slightly lighter grid (#2a5cb5 at 40-60% opacity), linework in white (#f2f7ff) and pale cyan (#9fd4ff). No other hues; accent only for a highlighted dimension (pale yellow) if needed.

geometry: Orthographic views (top/front/side) or plan; exact circles, arcs and tangents; centre marks; constructions drawn (bisectors, arcs) faintly; everything aligned to the grid.
stroke: Line hierarchy: 2.5 (outline), 1.5 (edges), 1 (hidden dashed 6 3), 0.6 (dimension/construction), 0.4 (grid). Butt caps, miter joins. Dash-dot (12 3 2 3) for centre lines.
texture: Paper grid only; optional faint fold creases; no shading.
composition: Sheet layout: outer border, inner drawing area, title block bottom-right, main view centred, secondary views arranged around it; notes in small caps at left; scale bar.
typography: Monospace or single-stroke technical lettering (uppercase), 3 sizes; dimension text centred on dimension lines with a gap.
lighting_depth: None. Depth by projection lines between views and line hierarchy.
svg_techniques: grid = two <pattern>s (10 and 50 unit) filled into a rect
dimension line as reusable <marker> arrowheads + <line> + <text> group defined via <symbol>
dashed styles through stroke-dasharray classes (hidden, centre)
title block as a table of <rect>/<line>/<text>; keep text as <text> monospace with generic fallback

name: Technical Illustration
description: Clear, explanatory line-and-tone drawings: precise linework with consistent weight hierarchy, cutaways/exploded views, numbered callouts and restrained tone to explain how something works.
visual_characteristics: clean contour + interior line hierarchy; hidden edges dashed when needed
light spot tones (greys or 1-2 colours) to separate parts; sparse shading
callout numbers with leader lines; arrows for motion/assembly; exploded parts aligned on axes

palette.guidance: White paper, near-black linework, a mid/light grey tone for parts, and 1-2 signal colours (safety orange, blue) to highlight moving or key parts. Low saturation elsewhere.

geometry: Isometric/axonometric or orthographic; exact circles as ellipses in projection; consistent draft angles; parts separated along exploded axes with dashed alignment lines.
stroke: Weights: 2 (silhouette), 1.2 (feature edges), 0.6 (detail/hatching), dashed 0.8 (hidden/alignment). Round joins for organic parts, miter for machined parts. Consistent across the sheet.
texture: Cross-hatching and fine line shading on curved parts; stipple for cast metal; parallel section hatch at 45 degrees in cutaways.
composition: Hero assembly centred, exploded parts fan along an axis, numbered callouts placed radially outside the drawing; legend or parts list at side.
typography: Single-stroke sans, small; callout numbers in circles; consistent size.
lighting_depth: Minimal: tone by direction to a single light (top-left), no cast shadows except a faint ground shadow; depth by overlap and line weight.
svg_techniques: define reusable part symbols and <use> them in the exploded layout
dashed alignment lines via stroke-dasharray class; arrows via <marker>
section hatch as <pattern rotate(45)> clipped to cut faces
callouts as a group: circle + text + leader line, reused via <symbol>

name: Scientific Illustration
description: Accurate, information-rich natural-history plates: naturalistic form with subtle tonal modelling, fine linework, labelled parts, scale bars and a calm specimen-plate layout.
visual_characteristics: fine contour + hatching/stipple/soft washes for form
multiple views (whole, detail, cross-section) arranged on a plate
labels with leader lines, Latin names, scale bar; cream plate background

palette.guidance: Cream plate (#f5efe0), sepia/brown-black ink (#3a2a1e), naturalistic muted washes for specimens (olive, ochre, umber, slate), one careful accent for the key feature.

geometry: Organic forms with accurate structure, symmetric where the species is symmetric; overlapping scales/feathers/leaves as repeated units with variation; plate border rule.
stroke: Thin (0.5-1.2) ink contours with varied weight; cross-hatch and stipple for tone; leader lines 0.5; round caps.
texture: Stipple (small circles via <pattern>), hatching for shadows, watercolour wash gradients within contours, faint paper tone.
composition: Plate layout: main specimen large and slightly off-centre, detail insets, caption block at bottom, inset scale bar, thin double border.
typography: Italic serif for Latin names, small caps for headings, tiny sans for callouts.
lighting_depth: Soft single light, gentle form shadows through hatch/wash; no cast shadows; delicate highlight left as paper.
svg_techniques: washes via gradient fills inside contour shapes with 0.6-0.9 opacity; do not blur
hatching by clipped <pattern> of fine lines or explicit line groups following form
repeated units (scales, feathers) via <use> with per-instance transform and tone variation

name: Infographic
description: Information design first: a strict hierarchy, consistent icon and chart grammar, aligned modules, and colour used to encode meaning rather than decorate.
visual_characteristics: clear reading order: title -> key number/insight -> supporting modules -> source/footer
consistent icon style and chart styling (one stroke weight, one corner radius)
colour encodes categories or emphasis; neutral greys for context
generous alignment, spacing and grouping (proximity, containers, dividers)

palette.guidance: Neutral base (white/off-white/dark), 1 primary accent + 3-4 categorical colours that are distinguishable (also by lightness for colour-blind safety), grey for secondary data.

geometry: Grid-locked modules; bars, lines, rings, dots as data marks with exact proportions; rounded rects for cards; consistent icon grid (e.g. 24 units with 2 unit stroke).
stroke: Uniform 2 unit stroke for icons and chart axes (round caps/joins); hairline 1 for gridlines; no other weights.
texture: None. Subtle background tints for grouping.
composition: 12-column mental grid; strong left-aligned or centred axis; hero stat large; charts scaled to data (compute bar lengths, angles from real numbers); footer with source.
typography: Two sizes ratio 1:1.6+ (title/labels), one family (sans), tabular-friendly numerals; hero numbers 3-4x body; keep labels short and legible at intended size (>= 12 units at 1000 wide).
lighting_depth: Flat. Optional 1-level card shadow at very low opacity; avoid 3D charts.
svg_techniques: compute all geometry from data in code (Python/JS) instead of eyeballing; emit <rect>/<path> with exact values
icons as <symbol> in defs with a consistent 24 grid; <use> for each
text as <text> with text-anchor for alignment; add <title> for accessibility
